U.A. school uniform.name: U.A. school uniform
U.A. school uniform.description: U.A.'s gray blazer edged in dark green, a white shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers or a dark green pleated skirt. Students wear it to lectures, ceremonies and school business off campus, and people across Japan recognize it on sight from the televised Sports Festival. It gives no protection in a fight. [ Armor | Issued at enrollment (about ¥45,000) ]
